title: Aye wafa ke paighambar
body:
Ae wafa ke paighambar nafse faatahe qaibar ae Hussain ke bhai
Dekhiye zara uthkar , aah qaimae at’har , lootne ko fouj aayi
Ho’we aayae tatheer , jinke chehro ki tanweer, un se bigde yu taqdeer
Farqe paak se chaadar, cheen le layee’n badhkar, Qalq ho tamashaayi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aapke kate shaane, koun iska gham jaane, koun hai jo pehchaane
Shaahedeen ki dikhtar, aur is qadar muztar, us pa kaisi ban aayi
Khoo’n hai kaano’n se jaari, kaise jaaye bechaari, shaam ki hai tayyari
Sailiyaa’n padhe’n rukh par, dar badar ba rehna sar, hai tumhaari shaidaai
<<DIVIDER>>
Waasta payambar ka waasta bahattar ka , ya khuda wo din dikhla
Dekhei’n rouzae anwar, aur adaa kare qaisar , qidmate jabi’n saayi
